{{Short description|Solid objects based on tetrahedrons}}
'''Polytetrahedron''' is a term used for three distinct types of objects, all based
on the [[tetrahedron]]:

*A [[Regular 4-polytope|regular convex 4-polytope]] made up of 600 [[Tetrahedron|tetrahedral]] [[cell (geometry)|cell]]s. It is more commonly known as a '''[[600-cell]]''' or '''hexacosichoron'''.
*A [[polyform]] of [[Regular polyhedron|regular]] tetrahedra.
*In [[origami]], a '''polypolyhedron''' is "a compound of multiple linked [[polyhedron|polyhedral]] skeletons with [[edge-uniform|uniform]] nonintersecting edges".<ref>{{harvcoltxt|Lang|2001}}</ref> There exist two topologically distinct polytetrahedra, each made up of four intersecting [[triangle]]s.
